name: Hone Waengarangi Morris
description: Named contributor in sourced geospatial conference and publication records.
story: BioWhere project outputs: NZGRC 2022 poster citation, Massey University lists Hone Morris as an author of “BioWhere: Georeferencing New Zealand's biota from texts”.

GIScience 2025 accepted abstracts, official conference programme lists Hone Waengarangi Morris as an author of “The BioWhere Gazetteer: A Culturally Enriched Place Name Knowledge Base for New Zealand”.
Massey University identifies the BioWhere collaborator as Hone Waengarangi Morris; the NZGRC source lists Hone Morris.
